algorithm: RIANN official pretrained six-axis recurrent attitude model
training_exposure_basis: The RIANN paper states that BROAD and TUM-VI were used for training and hyperparameter optimization. BROAD results are therefore not independent generalization evidence.

official_package.name: riann
official_package.source_match: The packaged inference Python source matches the pinned Git source; riann.onnx in the official source tree and wheel has the same SHA-256.

model.retrieval: Install the pinned official riann==0.2.0 wheel; adapter verifies the packaged model digest before creating an inference session.

inputs_outputs.accelerometer: m/s^2 specific force, x/y/z sensor axes
inputs_outputs.sampling_rate: uniform fs in Hz; dt=1/fs is supplied for every step
inputs_outputs.output: scalar-first (w,x,y,z) body-to-world orientation; no magnetic or independent heading input

source_fidelity.project_changes: Host-only wrapper validates the model SHA, uses the official RIANN.predict_step API, and replaces only the ONNX Runtime session with explicit one-thread CPU deterministic settings.
source_fidelity.default_model_resource_note: Adapter resolves riann/riann.onnx explicitly because RIANN() without onnx_path can fall back to current-working-directory paths when installed outside the source checkout.
